_comment: MERGE this 'hooks' block into ~/.claude/settings.json (do not overwrite the whole file).

hooks.command: python3 ~/.claude/anytype/sync.py reconcile >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "⚠️ Anytype memory sync 失敗（App 沒開或金鑰失效）——本 session 寫的 memory 只會留在本機、不會同步。修：開啟 Anytype 後跑 python3 ~/.claude/anytype/sync.py reconcile"
python3 ~/.claude/anytype/skills_catalog.py sync >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "⚠️ Anytype skills catalog sync 失敗（App 沒開或金鑰失效）——skill 目錄未同步。"
